lines: Yeah hi, I'm calling about my bill again.
This is the third month in a row you've charged me twice.
I want it credited today or I'm cancelling.
Hi, um, I got a letter about my account.
It says my service gets cut off Friday and I just lost my job.
I don't know what to do, I'm really scared.
Hi, I have a question about my statement.
There's a $14.99 line I don't recognize.
Which plan feature is that tied to, and when did it start?
Hi, I was looking at upgrading my plan.
I'm not sure the bigger one is worth it though.
Maybe I should think about it and call back.
Hi there! How's your day going?
So we just got back from the lake and the internet was out the whole time, what a week!
Anyway, long story, but my modem is blinking.
Hi, I need to update my card on file.
Sure, I have the account number ready.
Great, go ahead, that works for me.
